name: search_examples
description: Fetch ONE real-world implementation example per call, found by keyword across published s&box packages on sbox.game. Each call returns a single full source file; call again with the returned nextSkip only when more examples are needed.

detail.description: MCP response detail level. Defaults to compact; use full for a larger payload.

query.description: Keyword to find in real s&box source code, such as a type, method, or property name.

skip.description: Zero-based index of the example to fetch. Increase by 1 to fetch the next example.
